question: Which one of the following National Park-State pairs is correctly matched?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Similipal National Park - Odisha**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Similipal National Park** is located in the Mayurbhanj district of Odisha and is one of India's largest wildlife sanctuaries.
 
• The park derives its name from the red silk cotton trees (locally known as 'Simul') that bloom abundantly in the region.
 
• It was designated as a **tiger reserve in 1973** under Project Tiger and declared a national park in 1980.
 
• Similipal is known for its **rich biodiversity**, including species such as tigers, elephants, leopards, and a wide variety of flora and fauna.
 
• The park is also a part of the UNESCO-recognized **Similipal Biosphere Reserve**, which was established in 1994 to preserve the region's ecological diversity.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Namdapha National Park - Nagaland**

 
 
• This option is incorrect as Namdapha National Park is located in **Arunachal Pradesh**, not Nagaland.
 
• It is the largest protected area in the Eastern Himalayas and is famous for its incredible biodiversity.
 
• The park is home to four big cat species: tigers, leopards, clouded leopards, and snow leopards.
 
• Namdapha is also known for its dense forests and serves as a crucial habitat for several endangered species.
 
 
 
• **Bandipur National Park - Andhra Pradesh**
 
 
• This option is incorrect as Bandipur National Park is located in **Karnataka**, not Andhra Pradesh.
 
• It is part of the Nilgiri Biosphere Reserve and is renowned for its tiger population.
 
• The park also forms a part of the larger Nilgiri Hills, which include the adjoining Mudumalai Wildlife Sanctuary (Tamil Nadu) and Wayanad Wildlife Sanctuary (Kerala).
 
• It is a critical tiger reserve under Project Tiger and is also known for its rich wildlife, including elephants, gaurs, and numerous bird species.
 
 
 
• **Vansda National Park - Rajasthan**
 
 
• This option is incorrect as Vansda National Park is located in **Gujarat**, not Rajasthan.
 
• It is a small yet significant protected area in the Navsari district of Gujarat.
 
• The park is known for its dense forests and is home to several species of mammals, reptiles, and birds.
 
• It is part of the Western Ghats and contributes to the region's ecological balance.
